title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 74 (Public Assistance), Chapter 74.04 - General Provisions - Administration
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=74.04 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 74 / Chapter 74.04', heading 'Chapter 74.04 RCW - GENERAL PROVISIONS - ADMINISTRATION', section list beginning RCW 74.04.004 (Definitions - Fraud and abuse) and 74.04.005 (Definitions - Eligibility), with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links and an 'RCW dispositions' link. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: Chapter 74.04 is the general eligibility-and-administration chapter for public assistance in Washington and the natural single entry for this topic. Washington's TANF programme (WorkFirst) is chapter 74.08A RCW and general assistance is chapter 74.08 RCW; only one statute may be listed per topic.
